resolution.note: shippedMerge accepts a bulleted/quoted/backticked verdict line; lane refusals name the verdict line

title: A lane whose ship merged ends even when the verdict line is quoted, and a refusal names the verdict line
body:
Why: two lanes (t-0bct43k, t-t5qsy59) were refused their Stop after a merged ship because the final message lacked the line 'verdict: merged <sha>' at line start (status.md 18:21, 18:32; handoff finding).
Outcome: shippedMerge accepts the ship verdict anywhere in the final message (backticks, list bullet), still only when the sha is on the base; a lane subagent refusal names the remedy: end with the exact ship line 'verdict: merged <sha>'.
Proof: stop.test.ts cases for a quoted/bulleted verdict accepted and a refusal text naming the verdict line.
